title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a draft save naming no package, of an item never published into a package, takes the draft doors' address (#23657)
body:
Fixes #23657

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Dev session `session_01MNCZd8XNeUr1ihWwz3ecHZ`, dispatched by `domain:engine` seat 1 (`session_01GP3comALHRcRBixS2TEnLF`), claim 6196478876. The seat owes the review of the narrowing before the queue.

## What this does

Take an item never published into a package (no active row bound to one) whose drafts are bound to packages. A draft save that names no package (`PUT /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME?mode=draft`) now takes the address that PR #23654 gave the per-item publish and the draft discard naming none. Before, the save always wrote the package-unbound draft, because `SysMetadataRepository.resolveWriteHead` read the address from the active rows only.

| drafts stored (no active binding) | draft save naming no package, before | after (= publish and discard naming none) |
|---|---|---|
| none | creates the package-unbound draft | unchanged |
| package-unbound (with or without packages' drafts beside it) | updates the package-unbound draft | unchanged |
| only `Q`'s | **minted a package-unbound draft beside `Q`'s**, `200` | updates `Q`'s draft, receipt `package=Q` |
| `Q`'s and `R`'s, no package-unbound draft | **minted a package-unbound draft beside them**, `200` | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with the `?package=` remedy, nothing written |

- **One rule, one helper.** `unboundItemDraftAddress` (in `sys-metadata-repository.ts`, beside `packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal` and, like it, not on the package entry) is the "bound to none" arm of the draft address. `resolveWriteHead` asks it, so `put`, `headAt` and the strict draft read's `version` follow it. `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.packagelessDraftAddress` in `protocol.ts` asks it too, for the publish and the discard. The two callers can't share more than the pure rule: the repository reads inside the save's transaction through its engine, while the protocol reads outside it through `findEnvironmentRows` with its own unprovisioned-store discrimination. So both read the rows their own way and hand the bindings to the same function.
- **The refusal is not a second dialect.** In this state `put` raises `ambiguousPackages`, and that hits the existing `packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal('save', …)` branch, the one the #23297 two-active-packages arm already uses. The code, status and remedy are the ones the publish and the discard answer.
- **The discard receipt names the package.** It now reads "Draft discarded (package=Q) — TYPE/NAME. [seq=N]", the ` (package=…)` form the direct delete's receipt uses. Discarding a package-unbound draft gives the same bytes as before.
- **Unchanged.** An item with an active binding (#11087's inheritance from the active row). An item whose draft is package-unbound. A save that names a package.
- **Derived accept-set moves** (the save now writes Q's draft), named FROM → TO in the changeset: `If-Match` with Q's draft token goes from `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` to accepted; `If-None-Match: *` goes from a `200` create to `409 METADATA_CONFLICT`; a permission-set body declaring `packageId: Q` goes from `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (ADR-0086 D3, judged as a save into no package) to accepted.
- **The published description.** `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) now states the draft save's address in the words PR #23654 gave the publish and the discard (`'@objectstack/spec': patch`); it said "the env-local draft" whenever the active row was not package-bound. Description only: no key, type, enum or default moves.

ADR-0070 TL;DR 1 (the package-less state is not an authoring destination) and ADR-0048 (prefer-local: the package-unbound draft keeps the address when it exists) are the governing records. I grepped `docs/adr/` for the surface, and no ADR is reversed.

The landing point is the claim's file surface: `resolveWriteHead` and `protocol.ts`'s `packagelessDraftAddress` and its draft-discard receipt. `saveMetaItem` needed no change, because its draft save already delegates the address to `put`.

## Verification (head `23b58a388`, merge base `8c85141c5`)

- **Reproduced before the fix (H4)** at base `3bc407d30`, on the real stack (better-sqlite3, real ObjectQL, protocol and `RestServer` routes): the corner save answered `200` with `"Saved view 'case_grid' (env-wide, state=draft) [seq=2]"` (a package-unbound write); the two-package save answered `200` where `409` was expected; the discard receipt was `"Draft discarded — view/case_grid. [seq=0]"`. Result: 3 failed, 2 passed (the two controls).
- **Pins after the fix:**
  - `packages/rest/src/meta-draft-head-package-inheritance.test.ts` 21/21, with six `[#23657]` pins: the corner (save, strict draft read `version`, an `If-Match` save on it, publish, discard); a first-write pin (`If-None-Match: *`) refused `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` with Q's draft unchanged; the discard receipt; the two-package refusal on all three doors (`409` + `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` + `?package=`, nothing written); CONTROL active binding; CONTROL package-unbound draft.
  - `protocol.item-name-every-door.test.ts` 40/40, with the new ADR-0086 D3 pin: a permission set whose only draft is BOUND's, saved as a draft naming no package, is judged against BOUND (an agreeing body is accepted, a body naming another package is refused naming BOUND).
  - `sys-metadata-repository.draft-package-inherit.test.ts` `[#23657]`: one package's draft (`headAt` and `put` agree), two packages' drafts in both storage orders (`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`), an unbound draft beside packages' drafts, an active binding.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold`, the inheritance arm swapped for `null`, metadata-protocol rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in `dist/index.cjs` and `dist/index.js`): 4 pins red, namely the REST corner, the REST `If-None-Match: *`, the repository one-package pin and the permission-set pin; the two-package pins stay green (that arm was left intact). Restored with blob == HEAD `2f2030f9d205`, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` clean across 24 built files.
- **Fixture triage:** two #23495 fixtures in `protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts` reached an unbound draft beside a package's through the save this PR closes; they now seed that legacy row (`seedRow`), so both storage orders stay covered.
- **Spec:** `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId`'s draft arm rewritten in the words of the publish and discard descriptions (description only). Regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `gen:schema`, `gen:docs`; only `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` moved. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- **Suites on `23b58a388`:** `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 236 files passed, 3 skipped; 20566 tests passed, 19 skipped. Post-merge re-runs: rest `meta-draft-head-package-inheritance` + `meta-draft-read-door-census` 26/26; runtime `package-promote-runtime-owner-refusal.integration` (PR #23683's pin), `meta-published-runtime-publish`, `meta-save-preconditions-parity` 35/35. Earlier, at `60d1a418f` (the runtime change, unchanged since): rest full suite 290 files / 6085 tests; runtime draft doors 10 files / 848; objectql draft doors 9 files / 214.
- **Typecheck** on `23b58a388`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` exit 0; `@objectstack/rest` exit 0 at `4275150c5` (its typecheck runs `check:test-typecheck`).
- **Derived gates** on `23b58a388`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (9 paths), reconciled with `--ran`: 111 derived, 110 run (all exit 0), 1 NOT MEASURED (`node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, exit 3: the shallow clone cannot reach its pinned fixture commit), 0 unrun. `check:adr-0087-registration`: `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, one disposition.

## Neighbours

These open PRs touch `protocol.ts` / `sys-metadata-repository.ts`:
- PR #23683 (promote doors): landed on `main` (`954bf721f`), which changed `protocol.ts`; merged into this branch with a merge commit at `23b58a388` (no conflict), its runtime integration pin re-run green.
- The #23514 branch `claude/issue-23514-sentinel-owner-save` (no PR yet): merge-tree clean.
- PR #23418 (page rules, runtime door): overlap NOT MEASURED, because the shallow clone reports unrelated histories.

## Acceptance notes

- OQ3, measured, not fixed here: over drafts `[package-unbound, Q]` with no active binding, the strict draft read naming no package serves its `version` from the package-unbound draft in both storage orders, and its CONTENT from the first row the store returns (`findServedOverlayRow`, no package predicate). With Q's draft stored first (the protocol suite's in-memory double, insertion order) it served Q's body under the unbound draft's token; on better-sqlite3 both orders built here returned the unbound row first. The divergence predates this PR (with an unbound draft present the address was the unbound draft before too). Filed by the seat as #23715.
- #23495 and PR #23654 are referenced only as context.
